what_is_proven: Official SEC regulator publishes current Mutual Fund, Unit Trust and Fund Manager registries.
Current regulator counts observed: 53 Mutual Funds, 33 Unit Trusts, 83 Fund Managers.

Five representative manager source paths are mapped to regulator identities; CAL exposes daily dated PRICE, EDC dated fund values, Brassica explicit Bid/Offer, SDC current fund price and Databank periodic factsheet share prices.
missing_before_connector: Market-wide per-manager price-source coverage and historical depth.
Source terms/licensing/redistribution review.
Source-specific NAVPS/Bid/Offer/share-price semantics and canonical Fund/SubFund/ShareClass grain.
markets.next_probe: Run S2 no-write technical probes for CAL/EDC and build SEC-registry-to-pilot product mapping; no canonical import.

what_is_proven: Official CMA list exposes current schemes and nested sub-funds including multi-currency variants.
NCBA public fund page exposes a dated daily buy/sell price and states the daily price is calculated from NAV of issued units.
Etica, Britam, CIC and KCB official product/factsheet sources are current and mapped to CMA scheme identities.
missing_before_connector: Market-wide direct NAV/unit-price coverage; only one sampled direct daily price feed is certified.
Historical depth/stable URL patterns and terms/licensing.
Fund/SubFund/ShareClass model must preserve umbrella and multi-currency structure.
markets.next_probe: Run S2 no-write NCBA price-page probe; classify Etica/Britam/CIC/KCB as daily-price, periodic-factsheet or unavailable and map exact CMA sub-funds.

what_is_proven: FRA publishes current investment-fund sector performance reports.
Q2 2026 official report states 224 funds by end-June 2026 and updated fund classifications.
FRA public capital-market registers contain current fund entities and licensing dates, including 2026 entries.
missing_before_connector: A deterministic fund-only filter/export/count from the FRA mixed capital-market register is not yet certified.
Fund-level NAV/price publication path and cadence remain unproven.
Arabic/English identity normalization and manager/issuer relationships require explicit mapping.
markets.next_probe: Determine FRA category/type parameters or downloadable registry that reproducibly isolates investment funds, then sample fund-level NAV sources.

what_is_proven: FSCA officially registers managers of local CIS and approves foreign schemes/portfolios.
FSCA public regulated-entity/search surfaces and CIS/Hedge Fund registration/e-services are current.
Regulatory workflow explicitly models schemes, portfolios and foreign sub-funds.
missing_before_connector: Public reproducible extraction of current CIS managers/schemes/portfolios has not yet been certified from the exposed search/list surfaces.
Daily NAV/share-class source strategy and redistribution/licensing remain unresolved.
Large market requires explicit portfolio/share-class grain before acquisition.
markets.next_probe: Find/export current public FSCA CIS manager/scheme/portfolio lists, then compare with manager price feeds and licensing terms.

what_is_proven: FSC codified list current to July 2026 explicitly distinguishes single-fund CIS and multi-fund CIS authorisations.
Current 2026 public notices expose CIS revocations/surrenders and manager licence events, useful for lifecycle tracking.
missing_before_connector: Public active CIS universe extraction with stable fund/sub-fund identifiers is not yet certified.
AfricaFunds scope between domestic/local and Global Business/foreign schemes must be defined.
Fund-level NAV data source and redistribution rights remain unproven.
markets.next_probe: Locate current active-authorisation/entity register, define local-vs-global AfricaFunds scope, then sample NAV publication paths.

what_is_proven: NBFIRA publishes current regulated-entity and CIU legal/guidance surfaces.
CIU Act supports open-ended structures, umbrella/master/feeder concepts.
missing_before_connector: Public fund/scheme list extraction and stable scheme IDs.
Central NAV feed not proven; manager websites may be required.
Umbrella/sub-fund/share-class grain needs explicit mapping.
markets.next_probe: Extract NBFIRA licensed CIU entities, then sample major unit-trust managers for daily price feeds and factsheets.

what_is_proven: NAMFISA public register exposes multiple active Managers of Collective Investment Schemes.
FIMA implementation/regulatory material for CIS is current in 2026.
missing_before_connector: Scheme/sub-fund register rather than manager-only list.
Daily/unit-price source and fund identifiers.
Relationship to South African-domiciled or feeder structures.
markets.next_probe: Enumerate CIS managers from NAMFISA, locate their scheme portfolios and public NAV feeds, and tag cross-border/feeder relationships.

what_is_proven: ECMA published the Directive on Operation of Collective Investment Schemes on 23 September 2026.
CIS operator licensing framework is now formally defined.
missing_before_connector: Current licensed CIS operators/schemes and whether any live funds have begun publishing NAV.
Operational market data cadence and identifiers.
Very recent regulatory launch means production-data readiness cannot be assumed.
markets.next_probe: Check ECMA licensee announcements/register after directive effective publication; do not build ingestion until live schemes and disclosures exist.

rationale: P1 favors strong official scheme registries and manageable discovery path.
South Africa is data-rich but structurally/licensing complex; do not make it first connector.
Mauritius requires a product-scope decision because the regulator covers a large global-business universe.
Ethiopia is regulatory-watch until live CIS products/data are evidenced.

next_action: Await W2 CEMAC wrapped production preflight and Ghana/Kenya S2 source probes. Continue official-universe extraction for Egypt, South Africa and Mauritius; do not create connector tasks from regulator surfaces alone.
